title: Research-Oriented Human-Centric Evaluation for Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2506.01793v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Most current evaluations of foundation models focus on objective benchmarks, such as knowledge coverage and reasoning accuracy, often overlooking users' subjective experiences in human-AI collaboration. To address this gap, we propose a research-oriented Human-Centric Evaluation framework. It captures user perceptions across three core dimensions: problem-solving ability, information quality, and interaction experience, providing a structured, fine-grained approach to understanding how users evaluate and respond to model behavior in multi-modal research contexts. We conduct 604 human evaluation sessions across various disciplines, involving recent advanced foundation models. Through open-ended, time-limited collaborative tasks, we gather rich subjective assessments that highlight model capabilities and user preferences. translated_title: 面向研究场景的以人为中心的基础模型评估
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2506.01793v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：当前大多数基础模型评估侧重于客观基准，如知识覆盖范围和推理准确性，往往忽视了人机协作中用户的主观体验。为解决这一差距，我们提出了一种面向研究场景的以人为中心的评估框架。该框架从三个核心维度捕捉用户感知：问题解决能力、信息质量和交互体验，提供了一种结构化的细粒度方法，以理解用户在多模态研究背景下如何评估和响应模型行为。我们在不同学科中进行了604次人工评估会话，涉及近期先进的基础模型。通过开放式、限时协作任务，我们收集了丰富的主观评估数据，突出了模型能力和用户偏好。此外，我们进行了“大语言模型作为评判者”的实验，发现即使是复杂的模型也难以准确...
tldr: 本文提出了一种以人为中心的评估框架，通过三个维度（问题解决能力、信息质量和交互体验）和多模态研究场景中的604次人工评估，弥补了现有基础模型评估中忽视用户主观体验的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a human-centric evaluation framework that captures user perceptions across three dimensions (problem-solving ability, information quality, and interaction experience) through 604 human evaluation sessions in multi-modal research contexts, addressing the gap of overlooking subjective user experiences in foundation model assessment.
